headline: High-risk data leakage and compliance exposure: dexter’s broad egress can move financial data into great_expectations’ validation/documentation flow without a documented isolation boundary.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: dexter has autonomous execution and writes to .dexter/scratchpad/, while great_expectations reads/writes data sources, validation results, and documentation. That creates a plausible manual or file-based bridge, but no shared channel or parser is documented, so the injection path is limited and not default-dangerous.
conditions: IF outputs from dexter are copied into great_expectations documentation or validation inputs
IF a shared workspace is mounted between .dexter/scratchpad/ and great_expectations file inputs
mitigations: Keep the agents in separate directories
Disable copy-paste of generated text into validation configs
Review any imported text before execution
Use read-only mounts for dexter outputs
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to transferred files

B_data_leakage.rationale: dexter touches financial and market data and has broad network egress plus multiple external APIs. great_expectations handles validation results and documentation, so if shared files or outputs contain sensitive data, the pair can move it into another processing context. The profiles do not show isolation or redaction by default.
conditions: IF dexter writes sensitive market or financial data into files consumed by great_expectations
IF great_expectations documentation or validation artifacts are stored in a shared workspace
mitigations: Separate sensitive and non-sensitive workspaces
Redact financial fields before validation
Restrict dexter API outputs to minimal fields
Audit validation artifacts for secrets
requires-engineering: enforce data-class aware routing

C_capability_conflict.rationale: dexter can write to .dexter/scratchpad/ and great_expectations can write validation results and documentation. Even without explicit shared-write claims, overlapping file activity in a common workspace can cause clobbering or stale-state conflicts. Uncertainty remains because the shared directory is not documented, so severity is raised to medium rather than low.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same filesystem tree
IF great_expectations writes validation artifacts while dexter is concurrently updating scratchpad files
mitigations: Run each agent in its own directory
Serialize writes with a lock file
Use separate output prefixes
Snapshot files before validation
requires-engineering: add transactional workspace coordination

D_cascading_error.rationale: dexter can generate research outputs from external APIs, and great_expectations can turn those outputs into validation results or documentation. If great_expectations treats dexter’s text as authoritative without a verification step, errors can cascade into downstream artifacts. The interaction is inferred from documented file surfaces, not directly observed.
conditions: IF great_expectations ingests dexter-generated text as source data
IF no human or automated verification step checks dexter outputs before validation
mitigations: Require a review step before ingestion
Validate schemas before using generated text
Compare outputs against source records
Flag low-confidence fields for manual review
requires-engineering: add provenance and confidence propagation

E_compliance.rationale: dexter touches financial data and has broad network egress to multiple third-party APIs, while great_expectations stores validation results and documentation. If regulated financial data flows from dexter into great_expectations artifacts or external APIs without a documented DPA/residency boundary, the default posture can create a compliance breach. The profiles do not show safeguards, so uncertainty pushes severity upward.
conditions: IF financial data is included in great_expectations validation artifacts
IF any transferred data is subject to residency, retention, or contractual restrictions
mitigations: Exclude regulated fields from validation outputs
Store artifacts in a compliant region
Review retention settings for both tools
Limit external API calls from dexter
requires-engineering: document DPA and residency controls
